title: Operator: GitHub Support purges the six PR refs that serve client code on krn-works/krn
body:
Why: decision d-fe0823 (Fable, 2026-11-15): keep krn-works/krn public and have GitHub Support purge PR refs 868/871/872/874/875/878 that serve operator client code. agent-browser has no logged-in GitHub session.
Outcome: the operator submits .krn/runs/lead/operator-grant-1115/github-support-purge-draft.md at support.github.com as krn-works owner; after the reply, git ls-remote origin 'refs/pull/8*' lists none of the six and the head SHA URLs 404.
Proof: for n in 868 871 872 874 875 878; do git ls-remote origin refs/pull/$n/head; done prints nothing.
